utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Dane — I’m happy to help with the carpool. What days and times are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Mara — thanks. I’m usually free on Tuesdays and Thursdays around 8:00 AM, and I can do pickup in the afternoon too.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great — Tuesdays and Thursdays at 8:00 AM work for me, and I can help coordinate afternoon pickup too. I’ll keep that in mind and we can nail down the route next.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — what time are we aiming for, and how many people are in the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m checking the details now — I just need to confirm the time and the headcount before I say for sure.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No rush — just send me the time and headcount when you have them, and I’ll plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on the carpool supplies and make sure we’ve got everything ready.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks, Cleo — that’d be really helpful. I might forget a few things, so I appreciate you keeping track.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely — I’ll keep a running list and let you know if anything’s missing. We’ll have it ready for carpool.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the carpool — what are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’d be a big help, Rey. I’m just trying to figure out the timing and who’s picking up whom so nobody gets left waiting.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help sort that out. Tell me the pickup spots and times, and I’ll help make a simple route.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Nell, are we still on for the carpool this morning?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yep, I think so — I just heard it’s still on. I’m checking one more thing, but I should be good.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks. Just text me if anything changes, and I’ll be ready.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, right — I heard the carpool’s still on for tomorrow, but maybe check the pickup time in case it shifted a bit.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I’ll double-check the pickup time and let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Gus — appreciate it. If it changed, just give me a shout and I’ll adjust.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sure thing—I’ll check who’s in for the carpool and pass the word along right away.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Quinn—please let me know the final headcount and pickup spot when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll get the headcount and pickup spot to you as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can help with the carpool. What time do you need me?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm you’re free at 7:30 tomorrow morning?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes — I’m free at 7:30 tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Bo — I’m pulling the carpool together now. What time works best for you, and how many seats do you need?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m happy to fit it around your schedule — just tell me your best pickup time and whether you need one seat or a few.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll repeat the carpool plan to everyone so we’re all on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Vik — that’s a good idea. I appreciate you keeping it clear for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll make sure everyone hears the same carpool plan.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the carpool. I’m a bit foggy, but I’m happy to help sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. I appreciate it—I'm still trying to keep the carpool straight.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — let’s just make a simple list of who’s riding when, and I’ll try not to mix it up.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure — I can help with the carpool. What time are we thinking, and who needs a ride?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Jules — I’m thinking around 7:30, and it’s just Sam and me who need a ride.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: 7:30 works for me — I can pick up you and Sam. Just send me the address, and I’ll swing by.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Dane, I’m putting together a carpool and can add you if you want.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, that’d be great — thanks for adding me.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great — I’ll put you down and share the pickup details soon.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I can help with the carpool. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Rey. Could you handle pickup on Tuesdays and Thursdays, and I’ll keep the schedule updated.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can do Tuesdays and Thursdays.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can handle the carpool this week—what pickup times are you thinking for school?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Faye — could you do school pickup at 3:15 and then swing by my place after? If that works, I’ll make sure the kids are ready.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 3:15 works for school pickup, and I can swing by your place right after.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure thing — I can help coordinate the carpool and keep everyone in the loop. Who’s riding and what time are we aiming for?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll check who’s in and get back to you with the ride list and pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — just send me the list when you have it, and I’ll help line up the pickups.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — if you need anything for the carpool, I’ve got a few tools and can help out.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s kind of you, Gus. I just want to make sure the timing and pickup spots are all lined up first.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — let’s get the timing and pickup spots sorted first, and then I can help with anything else you need.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep track of the carpool spots—what time and pickup location are we using?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal — let’s use 7:30 a.m. at the corner by the mailbox. I’ll send the full pickup list so we can keep it organized.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect — I’ve got 7:30 a.m. at the mailbox corner, and I’ll keep an eye on the pickup list.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Hana, are we still on for the carpool this morning?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Mina — yes, I think so, but let me double-check the timing and text you back in a minute.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds good — just let me know the pickup time when you can.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the carpool. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Sam — could you take the Tuesday pickup and let me know if you need a booster seat?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can take the Tuesday pickup. I’ll let you know if I need a booster seat, thanks for checking.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, hey Noah — I’ve just been hearing bits and pieces, so what’s the latest on the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I’m not totally up to speed, but I think it’s still happening. I’d better check and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks — that’d be great. Just let me know when you hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure the carpool still picks up at 7:30?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, I’m pretty sure it’s still 7:30—nothing’s changed that I’ve heard. I can double-check if you want.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah, please double-check. I just want to make sure before I head out.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, hey Uli — any updates on the carpool? I’m happy to help coordinate if needed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Ira. I’m still figuring it out, but I’ll let you know as soon as I have something solid.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — just keep me posted, and I can help once you’ve got the details.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the carpool — I’m sorry, I keep losing track of these things. What time were you thinking, Leo?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No worries — how about 8:15?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: 8:15 works for me — thanks for reminding me, Leo.
